title: The Repair Man — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth trades
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The repair man arrives in a window between eight and twelve
And you clear your whole morning from everything else
Because the window is a window in name only — it's a day
The repair man will be there when the repair man decides to say

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El reparador llega en una ventana entre las ocho y las doce
[The repair man arrives in a window between eight and twelve]
Y limpias toda la mañana de todo lo que viene y se mueve
[And you clear your whole morning from everything that comes and goes]
Porque la ventana es ventana solo de nombre — es un día completo
[Because the window is a window in name only — it's a full day]
El reparador estará cuando él decida su decreto
[The repair man will be there when he decides his decree]

[Chorus — English]
The repair man knows something I don't know
He knows the fault before he opens anything in the show
The repair man has seen this particular problem forty times before
And the fix takes nine minutes and the quote took ninety more
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le réparateur arrive dans une fenêtre entre huit heures et midi
[The repair man arrives in a window between eight and twelve]
Et tu libères toute ta matinée de tout ce qui est dit
[And you clear your whole morning from everything that is said]
Parce que la fenêtre n'est une fenêtre que de nom — c'est une journée
[Because the window is a window in name only — it's a day]
Le réparateur viendra quand il le décidera — c'est décidé
[The repair man will come when he decides — it is decided]

[Outro — All three languages]
Repair man knows… El reparador sabe… Le réparateur sait
Nine minutes, forty years — Nueve minutos, cuarenta años — Neuf minutes, quarante ans
That's my boy
